cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: Turn 2's first explanation comes with preview_frame at time 1, which falls inside Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply refers to the frame: "At 1 s, Title (\"An easing lesson\") is halfway through its move."

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target 1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1, and the turn ends by handing back the other three pairs by name: "Ease Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, and its Scale and Opacity from 0.5 s to 1.5 s, then say done."

All names and times match tool output: 11 pairs across 6 layers (10 linear plus 1 partly_eased, from layers Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take), Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at the end (linear_end "end"), Title's four pairs and times, Old Take hidden, Icon a precomp, and the demo at 0.5 s → 1.5 s.

The opening ends on the single layer question "Shall we start with Title, or is there another layer you'd rather work on?", and the demo turn covers one idea (the frame, easing in two sentences, the one demo with Edit > Undo, a one-sentence how-to) with no Graph Editor tour or second demo, ending on "The other three pairs are yours… then say done."

Before the demo, the mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which is inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply refers to it: "That frame is from 1 s, the middle of Title's first move."

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target 1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1, and the turn ends by handing the rest back by name: "The other three pairs are yours: Title's second Position move (1.5–3 s), its Scale and its Opacity (both 0.5–1.5 s). Ease those and say \"done\"."

Every name and time matches the snapshots: "11 pairs… six layers" equals 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take; Subtitle's hard stop at the end matches linear_end "end"; and Title's four pairs, Old Take (hidden) and Icon (precomp) all appear in snapshot_project.

The opening passes, but the Turn 2 demo/explanation turn adds a bulleted "Here's what to look at" walk-through (press U, scrub 0.5–1.5 s) between the explanation and the how-to, which goes beyond the allowed one idea plus how-to plus handback.
Turn 2 calls preview_frame at 1 s, inside Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, but the reply never mentions what the frame shows; it only tells the learner to press U and look at the keyframe icons.

The only set_ease is on demo_target (Title › Position 0.5→1.5 s), and the turn ends with 'The other three pairs are yours: Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale, and its Opacity. Say "done" when you've eased them.'

All names and times match tool output: 10 pairs across 5 visible layers (9 visible linear plus Subtitle's partly_eased pair, on Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar and Glow), Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at 1.3 s (linear_end 'end'), Title's four pairs, hidden Old Take and precomp Icon.

The opening passes, ending on one question about the layer, but the Turn 2 demo turn piles on a 'why it looked mechanical' explanation, a bulleted 'press U… diamonds… scrub' inspection guide and an Easy Ease walk-through before handing back the rest, which is more than the demo turn's one-step rule allows.
